_description: Ordered error classifiers for tool_failure rows, read through lib/error_classes.py by failure-logger.py (at capture) and autoheal-aggregate.py (again at aggregation, from the stored error text, so edits here apply to old rows). Each regex (case-sensitive, re.search) runs against the redacted error text and the first match names the class. No match gives the default. Order matters: put specific shapes (hook denials, harness refusals, shell quirks) before broad ones (exit_code). "group_by_cmd_head": false marks a class whose cause does not depend on the command; the aggregator then keys its signature on (tool, "", class). Omitted means true. Tests override the path via CCGM_ERROR_CLASSES.

classes.name: hook_denial_branch_guard
classes.description: branch-guard.py blocked an edit or commit on the default branch.

classes.name: hook_denial_git_workflow
classes.description: enforce-git-workflow.py or check-careful.py blocked a git operation.

classes.name: harness_worktree_isolation
classes.regex: (?s)This agent is isolated in the worktree .*Refusing to run it
classes.description: Claude Code's harness refused a worktree-isolated subagent's command: too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree (compound commands, loops, eval, here-documents), or aimed at paths outside it.

classes.name: zsh_no_matches
classes.description: zsh expanded an unquoted glob that matched nothing (for example --include=*.sh).

classes.name: command_not_found
classes.description: The program does not exist on PATH.

classes.name: zsh_not_found
classes.description: zsh =word expansion on an unquoted word that starts with = (for example echo ==== separators).

classes.name: pathspec_no_match
classes.description: git pathspec resolved from the wrong directory or names a missing file.

classes.name: no_such_file
classes.description: A path argument does not exist.

classes.name: timeout
classes.description: The command or request ran past its time limit.

classes.name: exit_code
classes.description: Non-zero exit with no more specific shape recognised.
